chunks.content:
Title: Harbour Lights — Episode 1 "The Return"
Draft: 2

INT. KAMALA'S HOUSE - KITCHEN - DAWN

Kamala fries sprats over a wood fire. A radio plays the morning news softly. The door opens:
Nimal stands there with a rolling suitcase, thinner than she remembers.

NIMAL
(quietly)
අම්මේ, මම ආපහු ආවා.

Kamala does not turn around. She keeps stirring the pan.

KAMALA
කෑම කන්න වාඩි වෙන්න.
chunks.context_header: harbour-lights-ep01-script.fountain — script — INT. KAMALA'S HOUSE - KITCHEN - DAWN — model header 1
chunks.heading: INT. KAMALA'S HOUSE - KITCHEN - DAWN

chunks.content:
EXT. KALUGALA HARBOUR - BREAKWATER - MORNING

Sunil checks the nets on the family boat, the SEETHA. Waves slap the hull. Nimal walks down the
breakwater, shading his eyes against the sun.

SUNIL
මුහුද අද හරිම නපුරුයි.

NIMAL
බෝට්ටුවට කොච්චර ගණනක් ලැබෙයිද?

Sunil stops working and stares at his brother.
chunks.context_header: harbour-lights-ep01-script.fountain — script — EXT. KALUGALA HARBOUR - BREAKWATER - MORNING — model header 2
chunks.heading: EXT. KALUGALA HARBOUR - BREAKWATER - MORNING

chunks.content:
INT. AUCTION SHED - DAY

Fish are laid out on wet concrete. Mrs. Perera pours tea from a kettle into glasses and hands
one to Nimal, watching him closely. Buyers shout prices in the background.

MRS. PERERA
ඔයා කොහෙද හිටියේ මෙච්චර කාලයක්?

Nimal smiles and does not answer. He looks at the ledger of debts pinned to the wall.
chunks.context_header: harbour-lights-ep01-script.fountain — script — INT. AUCTION SHED - DAY — model header 3
chunks.heading: INT. AUCTION SHED - DAY

chunks.content:
EXT. KAMALA'S HOUSE - FRONT YARD - EVENING

Under the jak tree, Nimal spreads a guesthouse plan on a plastic table. Kamala sweeps leaves and
refuses to look at it.

NIMAL
බෝට්ටුව විකුණුවොත් අපිට අලුත් දෙයක් පටන් ගන්න පුළුවන්.

KAMALA
(trembling, barely audible)
බෝට්ටුව විකුණන්න එපා.

She drops the broom and walks inside. The plan flutters off the table.
chunks.context_header: harbour-lights-ep01-script.fountain — script — EXT. KAMALA'S HOUSE - FRONT YARD - EVENING — model header 4
chunks.heading: EXT. KAMALA'S HOUSE - FRONT YARD - EVENING

chunks.content:
EXT. KALUGALA HARBOUR - NIGHT

The lighthouse beam sweeps across the water. Sunil sits alone on the bow of the SEETHA,
writing tide times in his notebook by lantern light. Nimal approaches with two cups of tea.

SUNIL
මට තව එක අවුරුද්දක් දෙන්න.

Nimal sits beside him. They watch the beam pass. Neither speaks.
chunks.context_header: harbour-lights-ep01-script.fountain — script — EXT. KALUGALA HARBOUR - NIGHT — model header 5
chunks.heading: EXT. KALUGALA HARBOUR - NIGHT

chunks.content:
INT. KAMALA'S HOUSE - BEDROOM - NIGHT

Kamala opens a tin trunk and takes out her husband's fishing licence. She holds it to the
window light. For the first time, her face breaks.

FADE OUT.
chunks.context_header: harbour-lights-ep01-script.fountain — script — INT. KAMALA'S HOUSE - BEDROOM - NIGHT — model header 6
chunks.heading: INT. KAMALA'S HOUSE - BEDROOM - NIGHT
